sentences.en: The Chancellor of the Exchequer has offered to resign.
The chancellor comes after the president of the parliament.
sentences.zh: 财政部长排在议长之后。

sentences.en: The German Chancellor is plagued by immigration problems.
sentences.zh: 德国总理正面临移民问题的困扰。
